items.exampleEn: All new buildings must be in compliance with fire safety rules.
items.exampleZh: 所有新建築都必須符合消防安全規定。

items.exampleEn: Most shops quickly complied when the new rule began.
items.exampleZh: 新規定上路後，大多數商店都很快配合遵守了。

items.exampleEn: These toys conform to strict safety standards.
items.exampleZh: 這些玩具符合嚴格的安全標準。

items.exampleEn: The old prison once held more than five hundred convicts.
items.exampleZh: 這座舊監獄曾經關過五百多名囚犯。

items.exampleEn: The jury took two days to reach a verdict.
items.exampleZh: 陪審團花了兩天才做出裁決。

items.exampleEn: Our office has clear rules against harassment.
items.exampleZh: 我們公司有明確的反騷擾規定。

items.exampleEn: Parking problems fall under the jurisdiction of the city government.
items.exampleZh: 停車問題屬於市政府的管轄範圍。

items.exampleEn: Each faction in the club wanted its own leader.
items.exampleZh: 社團裡的每個派系都想要自己的負責人。

items.exampleEn: A corps of young dancers opened the summer festival.
items.exampleZh: 一支由年輕舞者組成的舞團為夏季節慶揭開序幕。

items.sentenceEn: Many online games now let players report harassment from other players.
items.sentenceZh: 現在很多線上遊戲都讓玩家檢舉其他玩家的騷擾。

items.audioEn: After hearing all the evidence, the judge gave the verdict late on Friday.
items.audioZh: 聽完所有證據後，法官在週五晚間做出了判決。
items.questionZh: 法官什麼時候做出判決？

items.sentenceEn: The man was convicted of stealing from the post office.
items.sentenceZh: 那名男子因為偷竊郵局的財物而被判有罪。

items.sentenceEn: Our company takes compliance with privacy laws very seriously.
items.sentenceZh: 我們公司非常重視遵守隱私相關法規。

items.stemEn: The two judges could not agree, so the ____ was delayed.
items.stemZh: 兩位法官意見不同，所以判決延後了。

items.stemEn: If you do not ____ with the rules, the bank may close your account.
items.stemZh: 如果你不遵守規定，銀行可能會關閉你的帳戶。

items.passageEn: Last month, Mia called the town hall because the lights on her street had been broken for weeks. A clerk explained that the street was outside the town's jurisdiction, so the repair had to be requested from the next district. Mia also learned why nothing had happened earlier: the neighbors' association had split into two factions, one wanting new lamps and the other wanting the old ones fixed. In the end, a volunteer corps of retired electricians offered to help. They made sure every lamp would comply with safety rules, and the district agreed to pay for the parts.
items.passageZh: 上個月，Mia 打電話到鎮公所，因為她家那條街的路燈已經壞了好幾週。一位職員說明，那條街不在本鎮的管轄範圍內，所以必須向隔壁區申請維修。Mia 也知道了為什麼一直沒有進展：住戶協會分裂成兩派，一派想換新燈，另一派想把舊燈修好。最後，一支由退休電工組成的志工隊主動提供協助。他們確保每一盞燈都符合安全規定，區公所也同意負擔零件的費用。

questions.questionZh: 為什麼要向隔壁區申請維修？
options: 鎮公所的電工全都已經退休離職了
那條街不在本鎮的管轄範圍內
隔壁區的零件價格比本鎮便宜很多

questions.questionZh: Mia 得知事情一直沒有進展的原因是什麼？
options: 協會負責人早就搬到外地去住了
兩派對換燈或修燈意見不合

items.promptZh: 所有包裹都必須符合郵局的尺寸規定。
referenceEn: All parcels must conform to the post office's size rules.
Every package has to conform to the size limits of the post office.
rubricZh: conform 表示「符合、遵守」，用法例如 conform to the rules、conform to standards 等
「尺寸規定」可寫，例如 size rules、size limits 等

items.instructionZh: 用 comply 造一個句子，說說你在生活中會遵守的一條規定。
referenceEn: I always comply with the library's rule about keeping quiet.
When I ride my scooter, I comply with the speed limit.
rubricZh: comply 表示「遵守」，用法例如 comply with the rules、comply with the law 等
句子要說到你自己的生活

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：人名 Mia 在中譯與題目中音譯為「米亞」，與本批其他課（Lisa、Paul、Ben 等中文欄保留英文名）體例不一致；建議統一保留 Mia。
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 中文欄保留英文名 Mia，題目同步

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：「協會的負責人搬到別的城市去了很久」中文不通順（「搬到…去了很久」），可改「協會負責人搬到外地很久了」。
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改「協會負責人早就搬到外地去住了」
